name: zone_occupancy_01
notes: Synchronized CAVIAR ThreePastShop1 views. Official XML identifies the three-person corridor sequence; the deterministic rule counts unique ByteTrack person IDs whose foot points lie inside a declared polygon and fires above max_occupancy=2. It does not claim to reproduce a learned crowd-counting model. Detection/tracking foundation: Ultralytics YOLO11 software (Jocher and Qiu, 2024) and Zhang et al., ByteTrack, ECCV 2022, arXiv:2110.06864. Dataset: EC-funded CAVIAR project IST 2001 37540, CC BY-SA.
